diagram_candidates.claim: A positively oriented compact geodesic triangular disk has three interior sector angles alpha, beta, gamma and satisfies integral_T K dA = alpha + beta + gamma - pi.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The theorem relates boundary orientation, three corners, and the curvature integral; a small labelled triangle can make the angle convention and orientation visible. The formula is already clear algebraically, so a diagram is optional.
diagram_candidates.suggested_content: A disk bounded by three directed geodesic sides in positive boundary orientation; label vertices and interior sectors alpha, beta, gamma, indicate the outward-normal-first boundary convention, and place integral_T K dA = alpha+beta+gamma-pi adjacent.
diagram_candidates.math_check: Confirm the arrows follow the induced positive boundary orientation, the labels alpha,beta,gamma denote interior angles (not exterior angles), and the sign in the formula remains plus the angle sum minus pi.

scope_and_limitations: Read-only local review of all frozen assignment sources, snapshots, captured HTML, screenshot metadata, and original PNG tiles.
